definitions: A firm decision to do or not to do something.
The quality of being determined or resolute.
The action of solving a problem, dispute, or contentious matter.
A formal expression of opinion or intention agreed on by an official body.
The smallest interval measurable by a scientific (especially optical or electronic) instrument; the fineness of detail that can be distinguished in an image.
The process or capability of a display device to render a sharp, clear image, typically measured in pixels.
examples: She made a New Year's resolution to exercise more.
His resolution to finish the project was admirable.
The resolution of the conflict took several months.
The UN passed a resolution condemning the actions.
The microscope has a high resolution.
